# ARR Reproducibility Checklist — Raw Materials

## 1. Training Hardware & Runtime

**Server**: westd-11235 (2× NVIDIA GPU, local)
**GPU allocation**: cuda:0 + cuda:1

### Per-condition training time (Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, 3 epochs, seed=42)

| Condition | Wall Clock (s) | GPU Hours | Notes |
|-----------|---------------|-----------|-------|
| no_trace | ~1,275 | 0.35 | shortest (no trace tokens) |
| exception_only | 4,541–7,507 | 1.3–2.1 | varies by seed |
| ae_only | ~6,398 | ~1.8 | similar to exception_only |
| loop_only | 7,426 | 2.06 | |
| vota_no_ae | 6,398 | 1.78 | |
| VOTA (full) | 8,443 | 2.35 | longest (most trace tokens) |
| full_trace | 7,852 | 2.18 | |
| label_only (full_trace + loss mask) | ~7,800 | ~2.2 | similar to full_trace |

### DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct (3 epochs, seed=42)

| Condition | Wall Clock (s) | GPU Hours |
|-----------|---------------|-----------|
| no_trace | ~1,200 | ~0.33 |
| exception_only | 6,246–6,384 | 1.7–1.8 |
| VOTA | 8,840 | 2.46 |
| full_trace (v3) | 8,891 | ~2.5 |

### DebugBench (Qwen, 3 epochs, seed=42)

| Condition | Wall Clock (s) | GPU Hours |
|-----------|---------------|-----------|
| no_trace | ~800 | ~0.22 |
| exception_only | 837 | 0.23 |
| VOTA | ~3,200 | ~0.9 |

**Total GPU compute**: ~50 GPU-hours across all experiments (including failed/killed runs and seed variations).

## 2. LoRA Hyperparameters

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| LoRA rank (r) | 16 |
| LoRA alpha | 32 |
| LoRA dropout | 0.05 |
| Target modules | q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj |
| Learning rate | 2e-4 |
| LR scheduler | cosine |
| Warmup ratio | 0.03 |
| Epochs | 3 |
| Per-device batch size | 4 |
| Gradient accumulation | 1 |
| Max sequence length | 2,048 tokens |
| Gradient checkpointing | Yes (for VOTA/exception_only) |
| Optimizer | AdamW (8-bit via bitsandbytes) |
| Weight decay | 0.01 |
| bf16 | Yes |

*Note: Verify exact values against `train/train_sft.py` defaults and command-line overrides.*

## 3. Dataset Split Details

### Main dataset (HumanEval + MBPP-sanitized)
- **Problems**: 591 unique (164 HumanEval + 427 MBPP-sanitized)
- **Candidate solutions**: Generated by Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct (10 per problem)
- **Total samples**: 5,910 (591 × 10)
- **Train/test split**: 80/20 → 4,720 train / 1,190 test
- **Class distribution**: ~71.51% pass / ~28.49% fail (majority baseline = 71.51%)
- **Deduplication**: Applied to training set (exact-match on normalized code)

### DebugBench dataset
- **Source**: DebugBench (Tian et al., 2024) — synthetically injected bugs in LeetCode solutions
- **Bug types**: logic errors, reference errors, syntax errors
- **Train/test split**: 1,622 train / 426 test
- **Class distribution**: ~51.41% pass / ~48.59% fail (near balanced)

## 4. Random Seed Strategy

- **Primary seed**: 42 (all conditions)
- **Robustness seeds**: 123, 456 (selected conditions)
- **Seed-tested conditions**:
  - exception_only (Qwen): seeds 42/123/456 → 99.83% ± 0.00 (perfectly robust, 2/1190 identical errors across all seeds)
  - exception_only (DeepSeek): seeds 42/123/456 → 99.33%/91.09%/99.33% (seed 123 outlier, LoRA initialization sensitivity)
  - VOTA (Qwen): seeds 42/456 → 99.41%/99.08%
  - ae_only (Qwen): seed 42 → 99.92%; seeds 123/456 in progress
  - label_only: seed 42 only (seeds 123/456 planned)
- **Other conditions**: single seed (42)

## 5. Evaluation Metrics Definitions

| Metric | Definition |
|--------|-----------|
| **Accuracy** | Fraction of correctly classified samples (pass/fail) |
| **Pass/Fail Precision** | TP/(TP+FP) for each class |
| **Pass/Fail Recall** | TP/(TP+FN) for each class |
| **Pass/Fail F1** | Harmonic mean of precision and recall per class |
| **95% CI** | Wilson score interval for accuracy |
| **ECE** | Expected Calibration Error — weighted average of |accuracy − confidence| across 10 equal-width bins |
| **MCE** | Maximum Calibration Error — max |accuracy − confidence| across bins |
| **Brier Score** | Mean squared error between predicted probability and true label |
| **McNemar's Test** | Paired test for significance of accuracy difference between two models on same test set (with continuity correction) |
| **Paired Bootstrap** | 10,000 bootstrap resamples, percentile CI, paired on sample IDs |

## 6. Code & Data Availability Statement

- **Code**: Training, evaluation, and data processing scripts available at [repository URL TBD]
- **Models**: LoRA adapters for all conditions available at [HuggingFace URL TBD]
- **Data**: Execution traces generated from HumanEval and MBPP-sanitized using Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct
  - Raw trace collection via Python `sys.settrace` instrumentation
  - VOTA compression via deterministic algorithm (no LLM in loop)
  - DebugBench traces from DebugBench dataset's provided solutions
- **Base models**: Publicly available
  - Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct (HuggingFace)
  - deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct (HuggingFace)
- **Compute**: All experiments reproducible on a single machine with 2× consumer/prosumer GPUs (~48GB total VRAM)
- **Licensing**: [TBD — check HumanEval, MBPP, DebugBench licenses]
